messages.subject: Re: hiding characters in textInput()
parts:
I get it. I think you want to mask your password.

There's an example there

http://getbootstrap.com/2.3.2/base-css.html#forms

Try this 

passwordTextInput <- function (inputId, label, value = "") 
{
    tagList(tags$label(label, `for` = inputId), tags$input(id = inputId, 
        type = "password", value = value))
}

Use this instead of textInput(). Let me know if it works. It's past midnight here.
